an3.10:1.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing three qualities and without having abandoned three stains, one is deposited in hell as if brought there.
an3.10:1.3: (1) One is immoral and has not abandoned the stain of immorality.
an3.10:1.4: (2) One is envious and has not abandoned the stain of envy.
an3.10:1.5: (3) One is miserly and has not abandoned the stain of miserliness.
an3.10:1.6: Possessing these three qualities and without having abandoned these three stains, one is deposited in hell as if brought there.
an3.10:2.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing three qualities and having abandoned three stains, one is deposited in heaven as if brought there.
an3.10:2.3: (1) One is virtuous and has abandoned the stain of immorality.
an3.10:2.4: (2) One is not envious and has abandoned the stain of envy.
an3.10:2.5: (3) One is not miserly and has abandoned the stain of miserliness.
an3.10:2.6: Possessing these three qualities and having abandoned these three stains, one is deposited in heaven as if brought there.”
